[center]hello! this is my [s]first[/s] [b]second[/b] official fashion sense mod, so if there are any bugs, please let me know!




[i][size=3]did you ever wish that you had more hair for fashion sense? [/size]
[size=4]if so, then this is the mod for you[/size][/i][size=4]! [/size][size=4] ( •̀ ω •́ )✧
[/size]

[/size][/i][i][size=5]
[/size][/i][size=5]✧✧✧[/size]
[size=6]
[color=#e06666]all the sprites were made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45760692]lemonsjh[/url]﻿, i just converted it to fashion sense!﻿(yes i did get permission to post it)[/color]
[/size]

[size=4]to use, unzip the file and place it into your mods folder! then open stardew valley, use the mirror and then in the hairstyles area, they should pop up![/size]
[size=4]all of the hairs are re-colorable btw[/size]

please go check out the original mod when you have the chance!
